facts.fact: Regulation 25-02 of 14 April 2025, under law 23-09 of June 2023, sets the rules for payment service providers, per TechCabal.

Law 23-09 created payment service providers as a category separate from banks, and the Conseil Monetaire et Bancaire authorised Djezzy Payment Services as the first on 23 September 2026, per TechCabal.
